================================================================================
modifiers in type patterns and record pattern components (ubiqlint)
================================================================================

class A {
  int f(Object o) {
    if (o instanceof Point(final int x, @Deprecated var y)) {}
    return switch (o) {
      case final String s -> 1;
      case @Deprecated final Integer i when i > 0 -> 2;
      default -> 0;
    };
  }
}
